faq.q: What is the origin of Aamirat?
faq.a: Aamirat is associated with Arabic. Plural form of عامرة.
Yes — the underlying form عامرات is Arabic.
Aamirat can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Aamirat should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. root ع م ر occurs in the Qur'an; عامرات is a sound feminine plural, not a Qur'anic proper name
